coptic_restorations.basis: Standard Greek loanword ⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ; only ⲟⲥ lost from ⲛⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ('the worlds'). Confirmed by lexicon: cosmos = ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ.

Lexicon-fixed: 'Pillar of Glory' = ⲡⲥⲧⲩⲗⲟⲥ ⲙ̄ⲡⲉⲁⲩ, the Perfect Man (ⲡⲣⲱⲙⲉ ⲉⲧⲭⲏⲕ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ). The first of three rocks is the path of regeneration; doctrinal context (Bearer of cosmos, foremost of omophoroi) confirms.
Reading ⲡⲉⲧⲁⲩⲧⲁϩⲙⲉϥ 'whom they summoned-him' (parallel to ⲡⲉⲧⲁⲩⲧⲁϩⲙⲉϥ in 3814 of the third rock). Only the vowel of the bound suffix is lost.
Standard agent marker ϩⲓⲧⲙ̄ ⲡ- before ⲧⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ ('by the Ambassador'); the syntax of ⲧⲁⲍⲙ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ requires expressed agent.
2-char lacuna with no editor proposal and no clear formulaic constraint. Could be a discourse particle, conjunction, or end of preceding clause. Honest non-restoration preferred.
3sg.m. perfective prefix completing the verb ⲭⲡⲟ (Lyc. variant of ϫⲡⲟ, 'set/establish'). Subject is the Pillar of Glory; matches the chain of ⲁϥ-verbs that follows (ⲁϥⲃⲓ, ⲁϥϣⲱⲡⲉ, ⲁϥⲥⲉϩⲟ, ⲁϥⲧⲁⲭⲣⲟ).
Completes ⲡⲕⲟⲥ|ⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣϥ̄ 'the entire cosmos' across the line break; standard idiom ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣϥ̄ (lexicon: cosmos = the natural mind in formation as a whole).
Possessive ⲛⲉϩⲃⲁⲙ 'his powers' (Lyc. ⲛⲉϩ- 3sg.m. + ⲃⲁⲙ pl. of ϭⲟⲙ 'power'); subject continues to be the Pillar.
Single ϩ completing ϩⲃⲏⲩⲉ 'works' (pl. of ϩⲱⲃ); 'all the works of those above and those below' is a fixed Manichaean idiom for the Pillar's universal establishing operation.
Feminine article on Ⲧⲙⲁϩⲥⲛ̄ⲧⲉ 'The second' (ordinal, parallel to Ⲧϣⲁⲣⲡ in 3802 and Ⲧⲙⲁϩϣⲁⲙⲧⲉ in 3814).
Feminine article on Ⲧⲙⲁϩϣⲁⲙⲧⲉ 'The third'; matches the ordinal series Ⲧϣⲁⲣⲡ — Ⲧⲙⲁϩⲥⲛ̄ⲧⲉ — Ⲧⲙⲁϩϣⲁⲙⲧⲉ.
Demonstrative Ⲛⲉⲓ̈ ⲛⲉ 'these are' opening the summary clause that gathers the three rocks just enumerated.
Trace of ⲉ visible; ⲓ completes ⲁⲩⲉⲓ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'they came forth' (the standard ⲉⲓ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ idiom of emanation/sending forth).
Genitive linker ⲛ before ⲕⲁϩⲧⲏϥ 'trust' after ⲟⲩⲛⲁⲃ 'great' (...out of a great trust); standard genitive morphology.
First half of ⲟⲩⲁⲉⲉⲧⲟⲩ 'they alone, by themselves'; the ⲟⲩ ends line 22 and the remainder starts line 23.
Combines with preceding ⲟⲩ to form ⲟⲩⲁⲉⲉⲧⲟⲩ 'they alone, by themselves'; standard reflexive intensifier closing the appointment-clause.

english_restorations.basis: Lexicon: ⲡⲥⲧⲩⲗⲟⲥ ⲙ̄ⲡⲉⲁⲩ = Pillar of Glory, the path of regeneration / Perfect Man bearing the cosmos. Doctrinal context (foremost heaven-bearer, foot from below to above) is the unmistakable Pillar.
Coptic restoration ϩⲓⲧⲙ ⲡ- is the standard agent marker; English supplies 'by the Ambassador' as agent of 'they summoned forth' in the previous line.
{5}=ⲁϥ supplies the 3sg.m. subject pronoun of the verb ⲭⲡⲟ ('set'). {4} remains unrestorable but does not require a separate English token.
ⲛⲉϩ- is the 3sg.m. possessive on ⲃⲁⲙ ('powers'); rendered 'his powers' as a single English possessive phrase.
Single Coptic ϩ completes ϩⲃⲏⲩⲉ; the lexical content of the English noun depends on this restoration. Standard rendering of ϩⲃⲏⲩⲉ = works/things.
Feminine article Ⲧ- on the ordinal Ⲧⲙⲁϩⲥⲛ̄ⲧⲉ; English 'The second' opens the second of the three foundations.
Feminine article Ⲧ- on the ordinal Ⲧⲙⲁϩϣⲁⲙⲧⲉ; English 'The third' opens the third of the three foundations.
Demonstrative Ⲛⲉⲓ̈ ⲛⲉ opens the summary clause; English 'These are the three great rocks...' gathers the rocks just enumerated.
Combined ⲟⲩ + ⲁⲉ + ⲉⲧⲟⲩ = ⲟⲩⲁⲉⲉⲧⲟⲩ 'they alone / by themselves'; one English phrase covers both Coptic halves of the reflexive intensifier, placed in 3819 per cross-segment continuity.

restoration_note: The teaching enumerates three foundations of glory the Lord lays within the natural mind: (1) the Pillar of Glory / Perfect Man (path of regeneration, the rational fully formed bearing the cosmos), (2) the new Land of Light set upon the land of darkness (humbling the storehouse and root of death), and (3) the great Thought = Jesus the Radiance (illumining wisdom in the rational). Most gaps are small editor-proposed completions (single letters, articles, possessives, agent markers, demonstratives) constrained by Coptic morphology and clear parallels within the teaching itself (the Ⲧϣⲁⲣⲡ / Ⲧⲙⲁϩⲥⲛ̄ⲧⲉ / Ⲧⲙⲁϩϣⲁⲙⲧⲉ ordinal series, the ⲡⲉⲧⲁⲩⲧⲁϩⲙⲉϥ summoning-formula, the ⲟⲩⲁⲉⲉⲧⲟⲩ reflexive split across lines). The substantive lexical restoration {1}=ⲡⲥⲧⲩⲗⲟⲥ is fixed by the lexicon entry for Pillar of Glory and confirmed by the Perfect-Man / heaven-bearer doctrinal context. Only {4} (a 2-char lacuna with no editor proposal and no formulaic anchor) is left unrestorable; the surrounding ⲁϥ-verb chain is intact without it.
